answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral and an anchor reputation, so coordinated equivocation by k identities triggers correlated penalties of O(k^2), rather than k independent fines. Detection then applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, rapidly exhausting shared funding and making false quorum control uneconomic. Quartz checkpoints and glacier-style escrow release preserve auditability while honest identities remain slashable only for proven faults.
